description: Successfully implemented deep monitoring integration and rich progress tracking for BenchBox CLI. Created ResourceMonitor class for background CPU/memory sampling, BenchmarkProgress class with rich.progress bars and live resource panels, and automatic PerformanceMonitor integration throughout the benchmark lifecycle. Includes 44 comprehensive tests (all passing), new CLI flags (--no-monitoring, --no-progress, --show-resources), and TTY detection with graceful degradation. Progress tracking enabled by default in interactive terminals.
